## Application Security  
### Development Security (Secure SDLC)  
**Code Review:**
- Peer review required before deployment
- Security-focused code review checklist
- Authorization controls review
- SQL injection/XSS prevention checks  
**Testing:**
- Unit testing (developers)
- Integration testing (QA)
- Security testing (penetration tests, vulnerability scans)
- Load testing (before production release)  
**Deployment:**
- Automated deployment (no manual prod changes)
- Change advisory board approval (changes to prod)
- Rollback plan documented
- Production monitoring enabled

raw_entities.name: Application Security Policy
raw_entities.description: Policy governing secure software development lifecycle (SDLC) practices, including code review requirements, testing protocols, and deployment controls to prevent security vulnerabilities in production systems.

raw_entities.name: Peer Code Review Before Deployment
raw_entities.description: Mandatory requirement that all code must undergo peer review prior to deployment to production systems.

raw_entities.name: Security-Focused Code Review Checklist
raw_entities.description: Requirement to apply a security-focused code review checklist during the peer review process to identify potential security flaws.

raw_entities.name: Authorization Controls Review
raw_entities.description: Requirement to review authorization controls as part of the code review process to ensure proper access management is implemented.

raw_entities.name: SQL Injection and XSS Prevention Checks
raw_entities.description: Requirement to perform checks during code review to verify prevention of SQL injection and cross-site scripting (XSS) vulnerabilities.

raw_entities.name: Unit Testing by Developers
raw_entities.description: Requirement for developers to conduct unit testing as part of the development and testing process.

raw_entities.name: Integration Testing by QA
raw_entities.description: Requirement for QA teams to perform integration testing to verify that system components work together correctly.

raw_entities.name: Security Testing Including Penetration Tests and Vulnerability Scans
raw_entities.description: Requirement to conduct security testing including penetration tests and vulnerability scans to identify and remediate security weaknesses.

raw_entities.name: Load Testing Before Production Release
raw_entities.description: Requirement to perform load testing prior to releasing applications to production to ensure system performance and stability.

raw_entities.name: Automated Deployment Without Manual Production Changes
raw_entities.description: Prohibition on manual changes to production systems; all deployments must be automated to reduce human error and maintain audit trails.

raw_entities.name: Change Advisory Board Approval for Production Changes
raw_entities.description: Requirement that all changes to production systems must receive approval from the Change Advisory Board before deployment.
context: Change advisory board approval (changes to prod)

raw_entities.name: Documented Rollback Plan
raw_entities.description: Requirement to document a rollback plan for each deployment to enable rapid recovery in case of deployment failure or issues.

raw_entities.name: Production Monitoring Enablement
raw_entities.description: Requirement to enable monitoring of production systems to detect and respond to operational issues and security incidents.

raw_entities.name: Peer Code Review Process
raw_entities.description: Control mechanism requiring peer review of code before deployment, incorporating security-focused checklists and authorization controls review.

raw_entities.name: Penetration Testing and Vulnerability Scanning
raw_entities.description: Security testing control measure to identify vulnerabilities through penetration tests and automated vulnerability scans.

raw_entities.name: Automated Deployment System
raw_entities.description: Automated deployment mechanism that eliminates manual production changes and ensures consistent, auditable deployment processes.

raw_entities.name: Production Monitoring System
raw_entities.description: Monitoring system enabled on production environments to track system performance, detect anomalies, and support incident response.

raw_entities.name: Developer
raw_entities.description: Developers are responsible for conducting unit testing and participating in peer code reviews before deployment.

raw_entities.name: QA Team
raw_entities.description: QA teams are responsible for performing integration testing and security testing including penetration tests and vulnerability scans.

raw_entities.name: Change Advisory Board
raw_entities.description: The Change Advisory Board is responsible for approving all changes to production systems before deployment.
context: Change advisory board approval (changes to prod)

raw_entities.name: SQL Injection Vulnerability
raw_entities.description: Security risk of SQL injection attacks that could allow unauthorized database access or manipulation, addressed through code review prevention checks.

raw_entities.name: Cross-Site Scripting Vulnerability
raw_entities.description: Security risk of cross-site scripting attacks that could compromise user sessions or data, addressed through code review prevention checks.

raw_entities.name: Unauthorized Access Risk
raw_entities.description: Risk of unauthorized access to systems or data due to inadequate authorization controls, mitigated through authorization controls review.

raw_entities.name: Production System Failure
raw_entities.description: Operational risk of production system failures due to inadequate testing or deployment issues, mitigated through load testing and rollback planning.

raw_entities.name: Undetected Security Vulnerabilities
raw_entities.description: Risk of deploying applications with undetected security vulnerabilities, mitigated through security testing including penetration tests and vulnerability scans.
